newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Yugoslavia holds 1997 wheat forecast at 2.8 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Yugoslavia holds 1997 wheat forecast at 2.8 mln T.

text.p: The second forecast for Yugoslavia's 1997 wheat crop put production remains at around 2.8 million tonnes, some 1.25 million more than last year, the Federal Statistics Office said on Friday.
The forecast, based on the state of crops on May 31, was unchanged from the figure issued on May 30.
Last year's wheat harvest plunged to a 25-year low of just 1.51 million tonnes from 2.97 million in 1995.
This year's wheat area of some 800,000 hectares is 217,000 ha up on the area harvested last year.
Expected yields per ha of around 3.44 tonnes are 860 kilos above last year's average.
Average yields on 183,000 ha sown by agricultural enterprises and farm cooperatives are expected to be some 4.03 tonnes and on the 617,000 ha sown on individual farms around 3.27 tonnes.
The Federal Statistics Office said it would issue its next forecast in mid-July based on the state of crops on June 20.
